KT COURIERS (PTY) LTD – TERMS AND CONDITIONS
Effective Date: 28 August 2024
Last Updated: 24 April 2026
1. INTRODUCTION
These Terms and Conditions (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of the KT COURIERS platform, including our website, mobile applications, and related services (collectively, the “Platform”).
By accessing or using the Platform, you agree to be legally bound by these Terms.
If you do not agree, you must not use the Platform.
2. DEFINITIONS
“KT COURIERS” / “we” / “us” / “our” refers to KT COURIERS (PTY) LTD.
“User” refers to any person using the Platform.
“Customer” refers to a User purchasing goods or delivery services.
“Vendor” refers to any business or individual listing or selling goods/services on the Platform.
“Delivery Personnel” / “Driver” refers to independent contractors performing deliveries.
“Services” refers to marketplace, logistics, and delivery services facilitated by KT COURIERS.
3. NATURE OF THE PLATFORM
KT COURIERS operates as a technology platform and logistics facilitator only.
We are not the seller, manufacturer, or owner of goods listed by Vendors.
All sales are concluded directly between Vendor and Customer.
KT COURIERS does not guarantee product legality, quality, safety, or compliance.
4. ELIGIBILITY
You must:
Be at least 18 years old
Have legal capacity to contract
Provide accurate and complete information
We reserve the right to verify identity and deny access at our discretion.
5. ACCOUNT REGISTRATION & SECURITY
You agree to:
Provide accurate, current information
Keep login details secure
Be responsible for all activity under your account
KT COURIERS may suspend or terminate accounts suspected of fraud or misuse.
6. PROHIBITED & RESTRICTED USE
You may not use the Platform for:
Illegal activities of any kind
Distribution or transport of illegal drugs or narcotics
Sale or delivery of counterfeit, stolen, or fraudulent goods
Transport of weapons, explosives, or hazardous materials (unless declared and approved)
Sale of prescription medication without proper licensing
Any activity that violates South African law
KT COURIERS reserves the right to:
Refuse or cancel any order
Inspect or flag suspicious parcels
Report activity to authorities including the South African Police Service
Permanently suspend or ban users
7. VENDOR OBLIGATIONS
Vendors warrant that:
All products and services comply with applicable laws
They hold all required licenses and permits
Listings are accurate, lawful, and not misleading
Regulated Goods
Pharmacy: Vendors must comply with requirements of the South African Pharmacy Council
Food: Vendors must comply with health and safety regulations
Other regulated goods: Must meet all legal requirements
KT COURIERS may remove listings or suspend Vendors for non-compliance.
8. DELIVERY PERSONNEL
Delivery Personnel:
Operate as independent contractors, not employees
Must comply with all laws and safety regulations
Must not knowingly transport illegal goods
Must report suspicious packages immediately
KT COURIERS is not liable for actions taken by Delivery Personnel outside Platform guidelines.
9. PARCEL HANDLING & INSPECTION
KT COURIERS does not guarantee inspection of all parcels
We reserve the right to inspect, refuse, delay, or cancel deliveries
Users are responsible for ensuring parcel contents are lawful
10. PAYMENTS & FEES
All applicable fees must be paid according to the payment terms displayed before confirmation. Where an eligible Cash on Delivery policy is offered, the configured online deposit is paid before confirmation and the outstanding balance is collected at delivery.
KT COURIERS may charge service fees, commissions, and administrative costs
Payments are processed via approved third-party providers
Refunds
Refunds are issued at KT COURIERS’ discretion for:
Failed deliveries
Incorrect orders
Verified disputes
Please report problems as soon as possible. Refund eligibility, requests and processing follow the Refund & Cancellation Policy. Mandatory rights under applicable South African law are preserved.
11. CANCELLATIONS
Customers may cancel within a limited time window
Vendors must fulfill accepted orders or risk penalties
KT COURIERS may cancel orders due to risk, fraud, or operational issues
12. DATA PROTECTION & PRIVACY
KT COURIERS processes personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).
We:
Collect only necessary data
Use data for service delivery and communication
Implement reasonable security safeguards
By using the Platform, you consent to:
Data sharing between Customers, Vendors, and Drivers for service fulfillment
13. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
All Platform content, branding, and technology remain the property of KT COURIERS.
You may not:
Copy, distribute, or reproduce content without permission
14. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
To the fullest extent permitted by law:
KT COURIERS is not liable for:
Product quality, legality, or safety
Vendor conduct or misrepresentation
Loss, damage, or delay of goods
Indirect or consequential damages
Use of the Platform is at your own risk.
15. INDEMNITY
You agree to indemnify and hold harmless KT COURIERS from any claims, damages, or legal actions arising from:
Your use of the Platform
Sale or transport of illegal or prohibited goods
Violation of laws or regulations
Breach of these Terms
16. MONITORING & ENFORCEMENT
KT COURIERS may:
Monitor transactions and activity
Suspend or terminate accounts without notice
Withhold payments pending investigation
Cooperate with law enforcement authorities
17. VERIFICATION (KTC)
KT COURIERS may require:
Identity verification
Business registration documents
Licenses for regulated categories
Failure to comply may result in suspension.
18. SERVICE AVAILABILITY
We do not guarantee uninterrupted access to the Platform.
Services may be modified, suspended, or discontinued at any time.
19. TERMINATION
KT COURIERS may terminate or suspend access:
For breach of these Terms
For suspected illegal or fraudulent activity
At our sole discretion
20. AMENDMENTS
We may update these Terms at any time.
Continued use of the Platform constitutes acceptance of updated Terms.
21. GOVERNING LAW
These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of South Africa.
Disputes will be resolved in South African courts.
22. CONTACT DETAILS
